text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
In short, a total of 99!!
Now, whatever could this number be for~!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The answer was: "The number of coconuts I smashed
with my bare hands during summer training camp"~!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Since you got it wrong, walk your butt all the way back to the Academy!
See ya!!

"...Before getting left behind,
I decided to hurry and get on the bus!!"
